                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Authentication configuration and lifecycle hooks.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See the [Auth overview](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/overview) for the\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * supported auth methods and how the `User` entity is connected to auth.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * If hooks are async, Wasp awaits them. All hooks receive `prisma` and `req`\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * in their input. Hook return values are ignored except for\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * {@link AuthHooks.onBeforeOAuthRedirect}, which can change the redirect URL.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * In TypeScript, you can type each hook implementation with its matching\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * type from `wasp/server/auth` (e.g. `OnBeforeSignupHook`). See\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * [Auth Hooks](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/auth-hooks) for the full hook\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * inputs and examples.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { app } from "@wasp.sh/spec"\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * export default app({\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   // ...\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   auth: {\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     userEntity: "User",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     methods: {\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       usernameAndPassword: {}, // use this or email, not both\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       google: {},\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       gitHub: {},\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     },\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     onAuthFailedRedirectTo: "/login",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   },\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * })\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface Auth extends AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Name of the Prisma model that represents the application user connected to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * your business logic.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The user entity needs to have an ID field that uniquely identifies each\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user. It can be of any name and type, but it needs to be marked with `@id`:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```prisma title="schema.prisma"\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * model User {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *   id Int @id @default(autoincrement())\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * You can add any other fields you want to the user entity. Make sure to also\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * define them in the `userSignupFields` field if they need to be set during\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the sign-up process.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Accessing User Data](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/entities) for how the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user entity connects to the rest of the auth system.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    userEntity: EntityName;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Enabled authentication methods. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    methods: AuthMethods;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Route that Wasp redirects unauthenticated users to when they try to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * access a page that has `authRequired: true`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +

                    [32m' * Creates an {@link Action} definition.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Actions are server-side write operations. Like queries, they can be\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * called from the client and the server. Listing entities in `config.entities`\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * lets Wasp invalidate related query caches when this action runs.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See [Actions](https://wasp.sh/docs/data-model/operations/actions).\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { app, action } from "@wasp.sh/spec"\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { createTask } from "./src/actions" with { type: "ref" }\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * export default app({\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   // ...\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   spec: [\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     action(createTask, { entities: ["Task"] }),\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   ],\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * })\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @param fn\n'[39m +
                    [32m" * Reference to the Action's NodeJS implementation.\n"[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See [the docs](https://wasp.sh/docs/data-model/operations/actions#implementing-actions) for details on the implementation and its context.\n'[39m +

                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @category Constructors\n'[39m +

                    [32m'export declare function action(fn: Action["fn"], config?: ActionConfig): Action;\n'[39m +

              input: {
                path: [32m'/home/user/app/src/actions.ts'[39m,
                content: [32m'export const applyCoupon = async (args: { code: string }, context: any) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const Coupon = context.entities.Coupon;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const coupon = await Coupon.findUnique({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    where: { code: args.code.toUpperCase() }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!coupon) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw new Error("Invalid coupon code");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return coupon;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'};\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export const checkout = async (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  args: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    items: { productId: number; quantity: number }[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    couponCode?: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  context: any\n'[39m +
                  [32m') => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const prisma = context.prisma;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!prisma) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw new Error("Prisma client not found in context");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!args.items || args.items.length === 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw new Error("Your cart is empty");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const isPostgres = process.env.DATABASE_URL?.startsWith("postgres") || process.env.DATABASE_URL?.startsWith("postgresql");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return await prisma.$transaction(async (tx: any) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let subtotal = 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const productMap: Record<number, any> = {};\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    for (const item of args.items) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (item.quantity <= 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        throw new Error("Quantity must be greater than 0");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      let product: any = null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (isPostgres) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const products = await tx.$queryRawUnsafe(\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          `SELECT * FROM "Product" WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE`,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          item.productId\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if (Array.isArray(products) && products.length > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          product = products[0];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        product = await tx.product.findUnique({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          where: { id: item.productId }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!product) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        throw new Error(`Product with ID ${item.productId} not found`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (product.inventory < item.quantity) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        throw new Error(`Insufficient inventory. Out of stock.`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      await tx.product.update({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        where: { id: product.id },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        data: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          inventory: product.inventory - item.quantity\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      subtotal += product.price * item.quantity;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      productMap[product.id] = product;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let discount = 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let coupon: any = null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (args.couponCode) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      coupon = await tx.coupon.findUnique({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        where: { code: args.couponCode.toUpperCase() }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!coupon) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        throw new Error("Invalid coupon code");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (coupon.type === "PERCENTAGE") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        discount = subtotal * (coupon.value / 100.0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } else if (coupon.type === "FLAT") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        discount = coupon.value;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    let total = subtotal - discount;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (total < 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      total = 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const order = await tx.order.create({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      data: {\n'[39m +

                    [32m'     * your business logic.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +

                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Route that Wasp redirects users to after a successful login or signup.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m"     * Only takes effect when using Wasp's built-in Auth UI.\n"[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +

                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAuthSucceededRedirectTo?: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'interface AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before the user is created. Receives `providerId` plus the common\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * hook input. Throw from this hook to reject a signup based on custom\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    onBeforeSignup?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called after the user is created. Receives `providerId`, the created\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * `user`, and, for social auth, `oauth` fields including tokens and the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * unique OAuth request ID.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterSignup?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Called once, after the user verifies their email. Receives `email` and `user`. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterEmailVerified?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before redirecting the user to the OAuth provider. Receives the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * generated `url` and `oauth.uniqueRequestId`. Return `{ url }` to override\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the redirect URL.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeOAuthRedirect?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before the user is logged in. Receives `providerId` and `user`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Throw from this hook to reject a login based on custom criteria.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeLogin?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called after a successful login. Receives `providerId`, `user`, and, for\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * social auth, `oauth` fields including tokens and the unique OAuth request\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ID.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterLogin?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Enabled authentication methods for the app.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * At most one local auth method ({@link LocalAuthMethods}) can be used, but you\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * can enable as many external auth methods ({@link ExternalAuthMethods}) as you\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * need.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export type AuthMethods = RequireOneOrNone<LocalAuthMethods> & ExternalAuthMethods;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Built-in local auth methods.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Pick at most one of these.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface LocalAuthMethods {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Enables username and password auth. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    usernameAndPassword: UsernameAndPasswordConfig;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Enables email and password auth with email verification and password\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * reset flows.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    email: EmailAuthConfig;\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    setCheckoutError(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCart((prev) => ({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...prev,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      [productId]: qty,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const removeFromCart = (productId: number) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCart((prev) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const updated = { ...prev };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      delete updated[productId];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return updated;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Calculations\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const subtotal = productList.reduce((acc, product) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const qty = cart[product.id] || 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return acc + product.price * qty;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }, 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let discount = 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (appliedCoupon) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (appliedCoupon.type === "PERCENTAGE") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      discount = subtotal * (appliedCoupon.value / 100.0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } else if (appliedCoupon.type === "FLAT") {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      discount = appliedCoupon.value;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const grandTotal = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Apply Coupon\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleApplyCoupon = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    e.preventDefault();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCouponMessage(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCouponError(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!couponCode.trim()) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponError("Please enter a coupon code");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const coupon = await applyCoupon({ code: couponCode });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setAppliedCoupon(coupon);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponMessage(`Coupon "${coupon.code}" applied successfully!`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err: any) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setAppliedCoupon(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponError(err.message || "Invalid coupon code");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Place Order\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handlePlaceOrder = async () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCheckoutMessage(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setCheckoutError(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const items = Object.entries(cart)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      .filter(([_, qty]) => qty > 0)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      .map(([productId, qty]) => ({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        productId: parseInt(productId, 10),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        quantity: qty,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (items.length === 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCheckoutError("Your cart is empty");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    setIsCheckingOut(true);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const result = await checkout({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        items,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        couponCode: appliedCoupon?.code,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCheckoutMessage(`Order placed successfully! Order ID: ${result.orderId}`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCart({});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setAppliedCoupon(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponCode("");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setCouponMessage(null);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      await refetch();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err: any) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const errMsg = err.message || String(err);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (errMsg.toLowerCase().includes("inventory") || errMsg.toLowerCase().includes("stock")) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        setCheckoutError("Insufficient inventory. Out of stock.");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        setCheckoutError(errMsg);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } finally {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      setIsCheckingOut(false);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const cartItems = productList.filter((p) => (cart[p.id] || 0) > 0);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    <div className="app-container">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <header className="header">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <h1>Wasp E-Commerce</h1>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      </header>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      <div className="main-content">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        {/* Product Catalog */}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <section className="catalog-section">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <h2>Product Catalog</h2>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <div className="products-grid">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            {productList.map((product) => (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              <div key={product.id} className="product-card">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <h3>{product.name}</h3>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <p className="price">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <p className="inventory">Available Inventory: {product.inventory}</p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <button\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  onClick={() => addToCart(product.id)}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  disabled={product.inventory === 0}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  className="add-to-cart-btn"\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                >\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  {product.inventory === 0 ? "Out of Stock" : "Add to Cart"}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                </button>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            ))}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        </section>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        {/* Shopping Cart */}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        <section className="cart-section">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          <h2>Your Shopping Cart</h2>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          {cartItems.length === 0 ? (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <p className="empty-cart-text">Your cart is empty. Add some products!</p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          ) : (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <div className="cart-content">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              <div className="cart-items">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                {cartItems.map((product) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  const qty = cart[product.id] || 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  return (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    <div key={product.id} className="cart-item">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                      <div className="item-info">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <h4>{product.name}</h4>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <p>${product.price.toFixed(2)} each</p>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                      </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                      <div className="item-actions">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <button onClick={() => updateQuantity(product.id, qty - 1)} className="qty-btn">-</button>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <span className="qty-display">{qty}</span>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <button onClick={() => updateQuantity(product.id, qty + 1)} className="qty-btn">+</button>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                        <button onClick={() => removeFromCart(product.id)} className="remove-btn">Remove</button>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                      </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                    </div>\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                  );\n'[39m +

                  [32m'              </div>\n'[39m +

                  [32m'                  type="text"\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +

            [32m'- NEVER skip hooks (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, etc) unless the user explicitly requests it\n'[39m +

Instead, after hook failure, fix the issue, re-stage, and create a NEW commit\n'[39m +
            [32m'- When staging files, prefer adding specific files by name rather than using "git add -A" or "git add .", which can accidentally include sensitive files (.env, credentials) or large binaries\n'[39m +
